title: Site search
summary: Site search in a window: a large rounded field and a separate results card under it over a light scrim, opened by a trigger or a key (Command/Control+K, /), a full-screen sheet on a phone. The panel asks a host through simai.search-port and draws what the host announces it can answer: grouped results, scopes, recent and popular queries, commands, a correction and a preview beside the list. Each block is also a setting, so the capability says what is possible and the setting says what is wanted. A page with no host of its own gets the built-in ones: a static JSON index (index) or a provider function.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

index.description: The address of a static JSON index (an array of entries, or {groups, items, popular}); the built-in index host reads it once and matches the query in it, case-insensitive, announcing scopes, recent, popular and actions. Not read when a provider or a connected port answers

for.description: The id of a page element, or several separated by spaces, that opens the window when pressed; the trigger slot is the other way

shortcut.description: The keys that open the window, separated by spaces: mod is Command or Control (Command on a Mac, Control elsewhere; either works); a single printable key (/) acts only outside a text field; empty: none

label.description: The window's accessible name; «Поиск по сайту» / «Site search» in the page language when not set

placeholder.description: The field's placeholder; «Найти на сайте» / «Search the site» in the page language when not set

scopes.description: Filter pills over the results once there is a query: all, then one per result group, each with its count. A want over the capability scopes: where the host does not announce it the pills are absent, and a setting cannot turn on what the host cannot do

recent.description: Recent queries on an empty field, each with a remove button, and a clear button (recent.forget, recent.clear). A want over the capability recent: the queries are the host's data, so where the host does not announce it the block is absent

recent-key.description: The name the built-in hosts (index, provider) keep this person's recent queries under, a view preference (SF.Preferences key sf-search/<recent-key>, in the browser localStorage sf-pref:sf-search/<recent-key>); give each search of a site its own; empty: kept for the page's life only. A connected host keeps its own, and the key is then not read

popular.description: Popular queries as pills on an empty field and under an empty result, from the data (popular). A want over the capability popular: absent where the host does not announce it

actions.description: Results that run a command instead of opening a page (kind action, with an optional key hint): a quick actions group on an empty field and their own group among the results, run through action.run. A want over the capability actions: no capability, no command rows

path.description: The result's path as a second line under its title. The panel's own setting: where a result stands is a field of the result, so no capability stands behind it

keys.description: A footer with the keys: arrows to select, Enter to open, Escape to clear or close. The panel's own setting: the keys are the panel's, so no capability stands behind it

provider.description: The simple path: async function (query, {scope, signal}) answering {groups: [{id, label}], items: [{id, group, title, path, href | action, icon, shortcut}], popular: [text]}; called for the empty query too (quick actions and popular queries). A built-in host of simai.search-port wraps it and announces scopes, recent, popular and actions; a host connected with connect-port answers instead. A property only

open.summary: Opens the window with an empty field; refused when a page cancels sf-search-open

close.summary: Closes the window; refused when it is closed already or a page cancels sf-search-close

toggle.summary: Opens the window when it is closed and closes it when it is open

sf-search-open.summary: The window is about to open: a request a page may cancel

sf-search-opened.summary: The window opened and its field has focus

sf-search-close.summary: The window is about to close, and why: the field's close button or the back arrow (close), Escape on an empty field (escape), a press on the scrim (outside), or the action and a chosen result (api)

sf-search-navigate.summary: A result was chosen (Enter or a press): the window has closed and the query is recorded; a page that routes itself or runs the action cancels it, else the browser goes to href. An action result carries action and no href

sf-search-intent.summary: The one event of the port (simai.search-port: every intent names it): the panel raised an intent and this is what came back, whatever the answer -- applied, refused, unavailable, and the answers the panel makes itself. A page may watch the exchange without standing in the way of it

payload.description: The payload raised, as simai.search-port declares it for that intent.

answer.description: The host's answer envelope {answer, reason?, text?, sequence?, data?}, or the panel's own when it answered without asking (port-not-connected, capability-not-provided).

forbidden_client_responsibilities: correcting a query the person did not correct

keyboard: Command/Control+K, or / outside a text field, opens the window
ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the selection through the results; Enter opens the selected one
Escape clears the field, and on an empty field closes the window and gives focus back
accessibility.focus: The open window puts focus in its field, keeps Tab inside while it is the top layer and gives focus back to what had it (the trigger) when it closes.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-search for the site search of a SIMAI site or documentation, and for a command palette: a window opened from a button in the header or by Command/Control+K, over a host of simai.search-port, a static index (index) or a provider function.
do_not: Do not draw a search window of your own on a SIMAI site
Do not put the results into the trigger slot; they come from the host, the provider or the index
Do not handle Escape or the shortcut yourself; the component and the layer stack do
Do not turn a block on with its setting where the host does not announce the capability: the setting is a want, not a switch on the host
Do not keep the recent queries in the page; they are the host's data (recent.forget, recent.clear)
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-search index="/search-index.json"><sf-button icon-start="search" text="Поиск" appearance="tonal" scheme="on-surface" radius="rounded"></sf-button></sf-search>
